message.name: CorporateActionInstructionStatementReportV14
message.definition: Scope|The CorporateActionInstructionStatementReport message is sent by an account servicer to an account owner or its designated agent to report balances at the safekeeping account level for one or more corporate action events or at the corporate action event level for one or more safekeeping accounts.|Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent (the sub-function of the message is Duplicate),|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy),|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy Duplicate), using the relevant elements in the business application header (BAH).

rules.name: EventTypeRule
rules.text: If Code is present, the code OTHR must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate. ||If Code is present, the code CHAN must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change. ||If Code is present, the code REDM must only be used when the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the securities holders.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: AdditionalReasonInforrmationRule

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: SafekeepingPlaceRule
rules.text: SafekeepingPlace is only to be used by global custodians that allow their clients to specify where the securities are to be held, for example, in an ICSD account versus an account at the local CSD.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present then SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Rule
rules.text: If SafekeepingAccount is present, then BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: MultipleAccountAndStatementDetailsRule
rules.text: If StatementGeneralDetails/ReportingType is MASE (Multiple Accounts) then AccountAndStatementDetails may be repeated and AccountAndStatementDetails/CorporateActionEventAndBalance must not be repeated in any occurrences of AccountAndStatementDetails.|If StatementGeneralDetails/ReportingType is SAME (Multiple Events) then AccountAndStatementDetails must not be repeated, and AccountAndStatementDetails/CorporateActionEventAndBalance may be repeated.

rules.name: CorporateActionEventAndBalanceRule
rules.text: If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is 'true' or '1' (Yes) then at least one occurrence of AccountAndStatementDetails/CorporateActionEventAndBalance must be present.|If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is 'false' or '0' (No) then AccountAndStatementDetails/CorporateActionEventAndBalance must not be present in any occurrences of AccountAndStatementDetails.

rules.name: PaginationRule
rules.text: If pagination is present, then StatementGeneralDetails/StatementIdentification must be present.
